ExternalConsumption.description: ExternalConsumption consumes a quota at a steady rate.

limit.description: Limit is the name of a quota limit of the provider.

description.description: Description is free text for humans.

name.description: Name of the document, unique per kind.

ratio.description: Ratio of the matching requests that fail (0 to 1).

routes.description:
Routes are globs on the route paths (* within a segment, ** across
segments). Empty means every route.

ScenarioLatency.description: ScenarioLatency is a log-normal response delay given by two quantiles.

p99.description: P99 is the 99th percentile, at least P50.

max.description: Max of the quota per window.

ScenarioSpec.description: ScenarioSpec is the specification of a Scenario.

ScenarioStep.description: ScenarioStep applies from at until at + for (or until the end), in simulated time since the simulator start.

at.description: At is the start of the step.

errors.description: Errors answers a ratio of the requests to matching routes with a status.

externalConsumption.description: ExternalConsumption simulates another client consuming a quota.

fixtures.description:
Fixtures replaces the fixture of routes, by route path, to simulate
inventory changes. Files are relative to the sim/ directory and take
the {var} placeholders of the route.

for.description: For is the duration of the step; empty means until the end.

latency.description: Latency delays the responses (log-normal, in simulated time).

limits.description: Limits overrides the max of named quota limits.

outage.description: Outage closes connections without a response.

tokenExpiry.description:
TokenExpiry invalidates, when the step starts, the tokens issued
before it.

description: A simulator scenario of a provider package (sim/scenarios/*.yaml).
title: Scenario
